name: Rosa Delgado
summary: Office manager with eight years keeping a busy dental practice and a small design firm running.

experience.title: Office Manager
bullets: Handled scheduling for the providers and the front desk team
Managed vendors for supplies, cleaning and equipment service
Processed invoices, tracked payments in Excel and sent weekly reports to the owner
Greeted patients, answered the phones and kept the waiting area in order
Trained new hires on the check-in process

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Booked travel and meetings for the three partners
Ordered office supplies and dealt with vendors when deliveries were wrong
Filed contracts and kept the shared drive organized
